item.title: Bus crash in city centre: Follow Live
item.description: A full emergency response is in place. Gardai and emergency services are at the scene of a major incident in Dublin city centre. A Bus Éireann vehicle crashed on the pedestrianised North Earl Street. The crash happened on the junction of Talbot Street and Marlborough Street.
